_evidence: 0x0041bb36 reads movsx byte [esi+0x72] (sel; any value: <1 is clamped to 1 at 0x41bb40, the sign is tested again at 0x41bb58 for the neg), then movzx ebp, byte [esi+0x1c6+max(sel,1)-1] and 'div ebp' of 0x100000 (edx=0). sel <= 127 so the table index spans +0x1c6..+0x244; every table byte is 1..255 so the divisor is nonzero and the quotient (<= 0x100000) fits: the original never faults. A zero table byte would be the original's own #DE, which its callers never pass (the table is a per-car divisor table).
